patches.name: use-oauth2-client-switches-as-default.patch
patches.reason: Use the portable Linux OAuth switch defaults (google_apis/api_key_cache.cc:256).

patches.name: fix-compiling-on-arm64.patch
patches.reason: The native arm64 musl build uses the locked native toolchains and arm64 V8; this patch targets bundled toolchain builds and an x64 V8 snapshot cross toolchain (build/toolchain/linux/BUILD.gn:179; tools/rust/build_rust.py:65).

patches.name: chromium-138-drop-nodejs-version-check.patch
patches.reason: The 156 source retains both Node version-check dependencies and the selected ungoogled patches do not remove them; the portable patch applies (third_party/node/node.gni:40; third_party/protobuf/proto_library.gni:603).

patches.name: chromium-153-revert-hermetic-python.patch
patches.reason: Use the portable .gn change to select system Python; the older Copium patch overlaps it and its Siso changes do not apply to Chromium 156 (.gn:14).

patches.name: chromium-154-use-system-tsc.patch
patches.reason: The desktop omits the DevTools frontend and uses the locked native TypeScript compiler for WebUI; the patch selects an unpinned system tsc and disables that compiler (ui/webui/webui_features.gni:36; scripts/linux_native_tools.py:82).

patches.name: chromium-155-use-system-esbuild.patch
patches.reason: The desktop omits the DevTools frontend and installs the locked native esbuild; the patch selects an unpinned system esbuild and its bundle.gni hunk does not apply (third_party/devtools-frontend/src/scripts/build/ninja/bundle.gni:61).

patches.name: chromium-156-remove-private-verification-tokens.patch
patches.reason: Apply the portable Chromium 156 private verification token change (chrome/browser/devtools/chrome_devtools_session.cc:83).

patches.name: chromium-156-revert-crubit-changes.patch
patches.reason: The native Rust toolchain supplies Crubit bindings, so neither the Alpine CBOR workaround nor the broader portable reverts to web package and font behavior are needed (components/cbor/BUILD.gn:15; third_party/blink/renderer/platform/fonts/BUILD.gn:21).

patches.name: chromium-156-revert-use-typescript-go.patch
patches.reason: The desktop uses the locked native TypeScript compiler; this patch reverts that path to the JavaScript compiler (tools/typescript/ts_library.gni:8).

patches.name: fc-cache-version.patch
patches.reason: Chromium 156 already uses FC_CACHE_VERSION for the fontconfig cache filename (third_party/test_fonts/fontconfig/generate_fontconfig_caches.cc:60).

patches.name: generic-sensor-include.patch
patches.reason: Chromium 156 already includes stddef.h and stdint.h in this header (services/device/public/cpp/generic_sensor/sensor_reading.h:8).

patches.name: musl-reserved-stack-limit.patch
patches.reason: Chromium 156 already detects musl on the main thread and returns null for its unreliable reserved stack limit, preserving the fallback for that case (v8/src/base/platform/platform-posix.cc:1507).

patches.name: musl-sandbox.patch
patches.reason: The narrower local seccomp patches retain Chromium restrictions while supporting musl thread creation and scheduling queries (sandbox/linux/seccomp-bpf-helpers/syscall_parameters_restrictions.cc:142).

patches.name: no-execinfo.patch
patches.reason: The local patch preserves the Alpine guards with Chromium 156 context changes (base/debug/stack_trace.cc:375).

patches.name: no-mallinfo.patch
patches.reason: The local patch preserves the Alpine mallinfo guards with Chromium 156 context changes (base/trace_event/malloc_dump_provider.cc:270).

patches.name: partalloc-no-tagging-arm64.patch
patches.reason: The local patch preserves the Alpine musl memory-tagging guards with Chromium 156 context changes (base/allocator/partition_allocator/partition_alloc.gni:113).

patches.name: pvalloc.patch
patches.reason: The local patch preserves the Alpine test guards with Chromium 156 context changes (base/allocator/partition_allocator/src/partition_alloc/shim/allocator_shim_unittest.cc:526).

patches.name: rust-cbor.patch
patches.reason: The locked native Rust toolchain contains a working cc_bindings_from_rs and Crubit support, so Chromium 156 can retain its CBOR Rust bindings (components/cbor/BUILD.gn:15).

patches.name: temp-failure-retry.patch
patches.reason: Chromium 156 sandbox/linux/suid no longer uses TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY (sandbox/linux/suid/process_util.h:11).

patches.name: cr143-libsync-__BEGIN_DECLS.patch
patches.reason: The local patch retains the Copium declaration fallback in the Chromium 156 header (third_party/libsync/src/include/ndk/sync.h:30).

patches.name: cr147-is-musl-libcxx.patch
patches.reason: The local patch retains the Copium musl libc++ configuration with Chromium 156 import context (build/config/c++/BUILD.gn:4).

patches.name: cr148-v8-no-san-trap.patch
patches.reason: The release graph uses trap-only undefined-behavior sanitizer without a sanitizer runtime (build/config/compiler/BUILD.gn:1621; v8/src/base/macros.h:225; v8/src/sandbox/testing.cc:53); musl-v8-sandbox-trap-ubsan.patch excludes that trap-only case while retaining ASan and MSan callbacks.

patches.name: cr151-dawn-armv7-is-real.patch
patches.reason: ARMv7-only Dawn source compatibility is outside native x86-64.

patches.name: cr151-dawn-cgo_enabled.patch
patches.reason: Dawn Go generation needs cgo explicitly disabled on Alpine.

patches.name: cr152-dawn-clang-22.patch
patches.reason: This build uses Chromium Clang 24, not Alpine Clang 22.

patches.name: cr152-ffmpeg-no-agtm.patch
patches.reason: The arm64 desktop keeps Chromium bundled FFmpeg (scripts/prepare-source.py:449); this patch adapts the system FFmpeg API and removes bundled AGTM handling.

patches.name: cr152-unbundle-minizip-undo-unicode.patch
patches.reason: This profile only unbundles FFmpeg.

patches.name: cr152-unbundle-opus-devtools.patch
patches.reason: This profile only unbundles FFmpeg.

patches.reason: The portable chromium-153-revert-hermetic-python.patch selects system Python in .gn; the remaining Siso patch hunks no longer apply and this build uses GN and Ninja (.gn:14).

patches.name: cr153-typescript-break-definitions.patch
patches.reason: Retain Chromium 153 TypeScript declaration compatibility.

patches.name: cr153-unbundle-opus-iamf.patch
patches.reason: This profile only unbundles FFmpeg.

patches.reason: The locked native Rust toolchain provides working Crubit bindings; retaining Chromium 156 bindings also preserves its new incremental-font-transfer target (third_party/blink/renderer/platform/fonts/BUILD.gn:21).
